data.gender_notes: Jeeval is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name 'Jeeval' comes from the Sanskrit word 'jeevan' which means 'lively' or 'vibrant'. It is often used to describe someone who is full of life and energy. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is known as the 'preserver of life' or 'jeevan prakashak'. This name is a tribute to the divine power of life and vitality. The name Jeeval carries the meaning “Lively, vibrant, or living” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jeeval usually hope their child will grow to embody lively, vibrant, or living and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: The Sanskrit word 'Jeeva' means 'living being'. It is used in Hinduism to refer to an individual soul or consciousness. In Hindu philosophy, it is believed that the soul is eternal and transmigrates from one body to another.

Jivaka was renowned for his amazing healing abilities and is considered one of the greatest physicians in Hindu mythology.
